journeys.name: two-listener synthetic Bot Connector turn
steps: start the scoped emulator Bun listener
start a separate caller-owned loopback ingress listener
follow the local OpenID document to direct JWK retrieval
issue a synthetic OAuth client-credentials token
deliver a signed Activity through the control boundary to the caller ingress
decode the Activity and receipt with Schema

must: tenant and conversation fields match the selected connection
all protocol envelopes carry their declared version
delivery uses one attempt and a bounded receipt
snapshot contains counts but no token, client secret, or private key
fresh Effect Platform TCP probes fail after finalization
must_not: use raw fetch or wall-clock polling
contact Microsoft or a public service URL
treat local success as Teams/Microsoft compatibility

journeys.name: standalone JSON scenario process lifecycle
steps: start it with one JSON ServerScenarioV1 file and one explicit loopback port
decode the one unteam.ready.v2 stdout line and the identical GET /ready response
read the external HTTP snapshot and touch the JWK route
send SIGTERM and observe child exit
prove the exact origin rejects a fresh TCP connection
start a second process and prove its snapshot is empty

must: malformed, wrong-version, excess-property, missing-file, invalid-port, and occupied-port inputs emit no readiness record
readiness contains only loopback URLs and no secret or local path
the child process and HTTP listener are distinct external resources
the second process has zero tokens, seen activities, JWK requests, and Connector transcripts
must_not: use a Pollsor-specific scenario or import Pollsor state
install manual signal handlers or a nested Effect runtime
treat a help document or stderr diagnostic as readiness
claim Microsoft, hosted, provider, or production behavior

journeys.name: false-green oracle
journeys.description: A test is false-green if it proves only an in-process fake or an HTTP 200 while skipping the real loopback boundary.
checks: the client is Effect Platform HttpClient
the server is Effect Platform BunHttpServer
the caller ingress is a second real loopback listener
the received body is decoded with ConnectorActivity
the listener-finalization probe runs after the outer Scope closes
the packed-artifact consumer imports the package tarballs rather than workspace source
the standalone-process test executes the compiled artifact rather than calling the server Layer in-process
an external consumer can be configured with only the loopback origin and GET /ready
